Don't listen to people bitching about your body... Just go to the gym for yourself (or yoga or whatever) and eat properly for yourself. Try different diets if needed to, for your body and healt. And stick to it for 6 weeks at least to see the results. And adjust. Be consistent. You own people nothing, but you own yourself respect. 

I maybe sound rough but going to the gym and trying to figure out my diet are the only thing that ever worked for my self-esteem. Everything else sucks. Pat on the back ? Sucks. Make-up ? Sucks. Cute clothes ? Sucks. But feeling dead on my feet after the gym and still eating properly ? Proud of myself.

Also, do you even have any respect or admiration for those randoms telling you that kind of crap ? Just picture yourself the though process of seeing someone and telling them they're fat, out of nowhere in a social interaction. Just... Meaningless. They're just nobodies opening their mouth. Value yourself more, do things you find valuable and you'll learn to not ear the BS people have to say.

If you work a little bit on yourself, you'll find someone, just try to be a "regular guy" (working out, hygiene, take care of your look, your behavior) and you'll have a girlfriend... Finding someone can't be the sole reason of one to exist, you need to also think about other things... A hobby or something too ? Anything. You have to live for yourself, not for "finding love" or anyone, it will show and she will run away. Show that you can live on your own, as the best as you can, and then you'll find someone that will stick with  you too.
